note: Svalbard: Norway's Immigration Act doesn't apply there, so no one needs a visa or a work and residence permit from the Norwegian authorities to go there; everyone must have the means to live there, under the rules on rejection and expulsion (the Governor of Svalbard). Getting there through mainland Norway asks a Schengen visa of those who need one, which is the visits engine's.

sources.title: The Governor of Svalbard (Sysselmesteren), Entry and residence
sources.said: Although Svalbard is part of Norway, the Immigration Act does not apply to the archipelago. Foreigners do not need a visa or work and residence permits from the Norwegian authorities to travel to Svalbard.
